notes:
Top-line: SaaS KB vendor for mid-market help desks. Wants hosted API first — lowest friction. Primary constraints: high QPS (target 800-1,500 qps peak), latency SLO <100ms 95p for reranked answers, index size moderate (target initial corpus 300k-500k articles, expected growth to ~1.5M over 12 months). Cost sensitivity: aiming for <= $0.005/query (embeddings+rerank amortized).

Recent conversations: AE/Evelyn intro 2026-01-22 (screen share of product, quick perf numbers). SE Liam ran preliminary perf notes 2026-02-18 (see Fireflies id). Requested PoC: ingest 350k docs -> test throughput + reranking pipeline; measure embed storage cost and rerank latency. They use hybrid vector store today (Elastic + in-house reranker), evaluating move to managed inference to reduce ops.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML (Okta), EU data residency for EMEA subset, audit logs retention 1 year. Legal sent security questionnaire 2026-02-28; awaiting answers (blocker).

Quotes / paraphrase from CPO: "We need predictable unit economics at scale — if inference kills margins we won't move.", CPO also emphasized: "Rerank latency is our bottleneck, embeddings are cheaper but end-to-end latency matters."

POC specifics captured: ingest subset (350k), run synthetic 24h soak at 1k qps with realistic queries, evaluate recall@5 + rerank p95 latency, cost per query calc. SE notes: prefer Redwood hosted API to avoid managing GPUs; wants control knobs for batching / cache TTLs.

Sales friction: pricing on 1k+ sustained qps + long tail index growth, and legal SLA negotiation for EU residency. CSM flagged potential upsell to Dedicated in 12-18 months if performance/cost targets met.

- "Estimate 1.2M doc steady state in 12 mo"
- "Ask: sample cost calc per 100k qps-hours"

use_case_summary: SaaS customer-knowledge RAG: ingest KB + community Q&A, use dense retrieval + reranking to surface authoritative answers. Needs high QPS on hosted API, low end-to-end latency for chat and widget responses, and predictable cost per query for unit economics. Initial index moderate (300k-500k docs), growth to ~1.2-1.5M. Primary metrics: recall@5, rerank p95 latency, cost per query.
